minor.issue: Intermittent 502 'Blueprint engine unavailable' when gpt-5.4 appends prose after the JSON object. Backend log: 'blueprint train error: Extra data: line 1 column 688 (char 687)'. The ```-fence stripping regex (ascension.py:373) does not handle trailing commentary. Retry usually succeeds. Same fragility likely exists in /api/twin/simulate (ascension.py:95). Suggested fix: use json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw) or extract the first {...} block via regex before json.loads.

action_items: Harden JSON parsing in /api/legacy/blueprint/train and /api/twin/simulate: replace naive json.loads(re.sub fences...) with JSONDecoder().raw_decode or a first-{...} extractor so trailing LLM prose no longer causes 502s. Currently retries succeed but users can see a transient error banner.

rca_of_issue: MINOR FLAKINESS — POST /api/legacy/blueprint/train (and potentially /api/twin/simulate) intermittently 502s. Reproduction: call endpoint 5-10× in a row; roughly 1 in 5 returns 502. Backend log: ERROR:guardian:blueprint train error: Extra data: line 1 column 688 (char 687). Root cause: ascension.py:372-374 uses `raw = re.sub(r"^```(json)?|```$", "", str(resp).strip(), flags=re.M).strip(); bp = json.loads(raw)`. The regex only strips backtick fences; when gpt-5.4 appends a disclaimer or short prose after the closing brace, json.loads raises JSONDecodeError('Extra data') and the except-branch converts it to HTTPException 502. Mitigation implemented client-side (retry works), but a robust fix is: `bp, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(raw)` or `m = re.search(r'\{.*\}', raw, flags=re.DOTALL); json.loads(m.group(0))`. Apply the same pattern to twin_simulate (ascension.py:95) for consistency.
